# Influencer Butler

> Influencer Butler is an all-in-one toolkit for Amazon creators and
> influencers, published by The Social Media Posse LLC. It pairs a desktop app
> with a free companion Chrome extension and bundles 50+ tools
> ("butlers") to automate Amazon Creator Connections auto-accept, brand outreach,
> commission harvesting, deal posting, and storefront and content management.
> The desktop app runs on Windows and macOS. The free Chrome extension adds
> product research and Creator Connections intel to the Amazon pages you browse,
> and pairs with the desktop app on the same computer (a 6-digit code) so a
> product you spot in the browser becomes a one-tap action in the app.

## What it does

- Amazon Creator Connections: finds and auto-accepts matching paid campaigns on your criteria, so you never miss a time-limited brief.
- Brand outreach: sends personalized pitches at scale with per-day rate caps and human-like pacing.
- Commission harvesting: collects and totals affiliate commissions and highlights best-earning products.
- Deals and content: posts deals, refreshes storefront links, and manages content.
- 50+ tools across one desktop app and a free Chrome extension, instead of stitching together single-purpose point tools.

## Pricing

- Free-forever tier: the Chrome extension plus a set of core tools, no card required.
- Pro: $39 per month or $390 per year (a 17% saving), unlocks all 50+ tools.
- Trial: a 14-day Pro trial that unlocks everything; cancel before day 14 to avoid charges.

## Platform

- Windows and macOS (separate builds for Apple Silicon and Intel).
- Auto-updates. Built for the Amazon Creator Connections ecosystem and adjacent affiliate networks.
